qr.label: Add-a-friend QR code
qr.body: Your friend taps "Scan a QR code" in Bargu and scans this; you become friends right away. Single use, valid for 24 hours. Screenshots are blocked for your safety.
qr.circleBody: Whoever scans this code can join the circle. Single use, valid for 24 hours.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.body: If you accept, you can share your locations with each other, end-to-end encrypted. You can leave any time.
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid or has expired
invite.invalidBody: Invite links work once and for 24 hours. Ask your friend for a new one.

errors.full: This circle is full (50 people at most).
errors.gone: This circle no longer exists or you're not in it.

sheet.friendRequest: Wants to add you as a friend

new.title: New circle
new.body: Set up a circle for your family or friends, then invite people. Anyone who hasn't accepted sees nothing.
new.name: Circle name
new.inviteBody: Tap to pick; you can add more later. Anyone who hasn't accepted sees nothing.

detail.goneBody: You may have left it or been removed.
detail.encryptedBody: Locations open only on the phones of the people here. Not even Bargu's server can see them.
detail.waitingBody: Keys still to arrive: {{count}}. It completes by itself once they open the app.
detail.pendingBody: You'll see {{name}} here once they accept. Nothing is shared until then.
detail.keyChangedBody: It may be a new phone. Until you're sure, your location isn't sent to them and their key isn't used.
detail.acceptKeyBody: If {{name}} changed phones, you can accept. Safest is to meet and compare with the QR code.
detail.removeBody: They won't see any further locations; new keys go only to those who stay.
detail.leaveBody: People in this circle won't see your location any more, and you won't see theirs.
detail.unfriendBody: Neither of you will see the other's location. Becoming friends again needs a new request.
detail.onlyYouBody: Invite your friends; those who accept join the circle.

invite.byUsernameHint: For someone not in your friends

verify.mismatchBody: Make sure you scanned the right person's code. If it still doesn't match, don't share your location with them.

notices.friendRequest: {{name}} wants to add you as a friend
notices.keyChanged: {{names}}'s safety number changed. Tap to check.
